self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Starfire Upon the Snowplains: triggering any Elemental Reaction grants +32% ATK for 12s. Works off-field.

R5 Starfire Upon the Snowplains: triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG by 32% for 12s. Applied as stellarconduct_dmg_, the codebase key for Stellar Glimmer DMG — correct for a Stellar-Conduct rotation, and it undercounts a Stellar Swirl one, which the evaluator does not implement. Stacks with afterElementalReaction, since a Stellar Glimmer reaction is also an Elemental Reaction.

source.note: 7.0 weapon, added 2026-08-08 from nanoka 6.7.54 beta data (neither Amber nor GO carry it yet). Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add, the same derivation validated to the cent against 15 existing seed files. Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1).
